detail.longDescription: I have a Laravel route with an optional {barcode?} parameter. I want the barcodeSearch() controller method to be called even when the user clicks the search button without entering a barcode. Route Route::get('/serialization/search/{barcode?}', [SerializationController::class, 'barcodeSearch']); Controller public function barcodeSearch(Request $request, $barcode = null) { $data = Serialization::query(); $data->where(function ($query) use ($barcode) { $query->where("serial_emei_number", $barcode) ->orWhere("barcode_number", $barcode); }); if ($request->back_office_search == true) { $data->InBackoffice(); } else { $data->NotInBackoffice()->isNotSold(); } $data->with("fk_receiving_id", "fk_item_id", "fk_division_id"); $result = $data->first(); if ($result) { return response()->json($result); } return $this->responseMessage("ITEM NOT FOUND", 406); } Axios request function loadData(value) { axios.get(`{{$url}}/${value}`, { params: { type: "{{$type}}", back_office_search: "{{$back_office_search}}" } }) .then(function(response) { console.log(response.data); }); } when i request a correct or wrong barcode its returning the json response when searching without entering a value its not reaching the barcodeSearch function my aim is empty value should reach the barcodeSearch function and if the value is null or empty its should return the json response in network preview tab
